timestamp.description: The timestamp of the snapshot in RFC-3339 format with nanosecond precision.

total_market_value.description: The total market value of the account

cash_market_value.description: The cash market value of the account

other_market_value.description: The market value of all holdings that are not tracked by Moment. This includes all non-fixed income holdings and fixed income holdings that are not present in Moment's security master.

tracked_fixed_income_market_value.description: The tracked fixed income market value of the account -- this should be equal to the sum of treasury_market_value, corporate_market_value, agency_market_value, cd_market_value, municipal_market_value, and government_market_value

treasury_market_value.description: The treasury market value of the account

corporate_market_value.description: The corporate market value of the account

agency_market_value.description: The agency market value of the account

government_market_value.description: The government market value of the account

municipal_market_value.description: The municipal market value of the account

money_market_market_value.description: The money market market value of the account

cd_market_value.description: The CD market value of the account

total_accrued_interest.description: The total accrued interest of the account

average_ytw.description: The average yield to worst of the account

average_maturity.description: The average maturity of the account

average_duration.description: The average duration of the account

average_sp_rating.description: The average SP rating of the account

average_moodys_rating.description: The average Moody's rating of the account

average_coupon.description: The average coupon rate across all bonds in the account

average_book_ytm.description: The average yield to maturity calculated at purchase time using basis price and date

average_book_ytw.description: The average yield to worst calculated at purchase time using basis price and date
